=== COMPANY ===
CyanCast is the brand and trading company (Singapore-oriented), owning the brand and leading international sales, distribution and partner relationships. Xi Yan Broadcasting (希延广播), based in Guangzhou, China, is a separate company responsible for research, development and manufacturing — the wireless protocol, the hardware and build quality. Together they bring the Desktop Commercial Wireless Audio Hub to market: one host wirelessly broadcasts to an unlimited number of receiver terminals (up to 120 m open-space coverage), serving commercial sound, background music (BGM) and multi-zone paging for businesses and institutions worldwide. For outward contact, CyanCast is represented in Singapore by Ron Magee (罗恩·麦基), our trade liaison, Mr. Magee.

=== PRODUCT: Desktop Commercial Wireless Audio Hub ===
Type: Wireless audio host (sold as a kit: one host + multiple terminals)
Wireless protocol: Bluetooth Broadcast (not legacy 1-to-1 Bluetooth, so unlimited terminals)
Coverage: >= 120 meters in open space
Terminal capacity: Unlimited (recommended < 50 per zone for best audio quality)
Power: DC 12V / 2A
Inputs: Gooseneck MIC1 x1, MIC2 x1 (6.35mm), AUX x2 (RCA), USB x1
Zones: A/B dual-channel independent control
Special functions: MIC priority (auto-mute — background music ducks while speaking, then resumes), signal boost, secure private network (receivers stay undiscoverable until manually paired)

Key features:
- Unlimited wireless terminals via Bluetooth broadcast protocol
- Up to 120 m coverage with high-gain antenna and signal boost
- Low-latency sync across all terminals (ideal for live paging)
- Built-in gooseneck microphone for announcements
- MIC priority / auto-mute
- A/B independent zone control (e.g. music at front desk, mute the warehouse)
- Secure private network (terminals undiscoverable until paired)

Terminal forms (all pair with the same host):
- Ceiling speaker: 6 inch 6 W / 8 inch 15 W (malls, hotel lobbies)
- Wall-mount speaker: 4 inch wood 15 W / 5 inch plastic 30 W (corridors, classrooms, offices)
- Waterproof column: 4 inch 15 W / 4 inch 30 W (gardens, plazas, outdoor zones)

=== THREE SYSTEMS ===
1. Commercial Sound System — scalable wireless audio for retail, campus and factory floors.
2. Background Music System — BGM from USB/Bluetooth/AUX that never fights the mic (MIC priority).
3. Multi-Zone Audio System — independent A/B zone control from one host.

=== APPLICATIONS ===
- Church: wireless PA for clear sermons and hymn playback, zoned coverage, no cabling.
- Mosque: clear khutbah and calls to prayer, gooseneck mic, MIC priority.
- School / Campus: classroom, hall and outdoor paging with BGM, 120 m reach.
- Hotel: per-zone playlists (lobby, bar, restaurant, corridor) plus guest paging.
- Retail: atmosphere BGM plus staff paging, zone control (entrance, floor, checkout).
- Factory / Warehouse: rugged over-noise paging, no cabling, 120 m coverage.
- Restaurant: dining ambience plus counter paging, gooseneck mic, MIC priority.
- Corporate: meetings, training and zone paging, low-latency sync.
